claims.claim: FP8+s8 was the highest-throughput measured configuration for the synthetic agentic workload at concurrency 1, 2, and 4.
claims.notes: Output token mismatch cases were excluded from target comparisons.

claims.claim: For random workloads at spec_tokens=4, FP8 was at least parity with BF16 in all nine measured conditions under a five-percent parity threshold.
claims.notes: Eight FP8-faster and one parity condition.

claims.claim: FP8 slowdown cannot be explained solely by lower MTP acceptance.
claims.notes: At random s16/in1024/out1024/c8, FP8 was 18.26% slower while its measured acceptance was higher.

claims.claim: FP8+s8 is the optimal setting for real production agents.
claims.notes: Supported for the synthetic 512-token replay only; real tool API timing, short outputs, retries, and repeated runs are missing.
